'''March 2001 Green Bay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobbytown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin on 17 March 2001. [[Mark Kloida]] won it. It is known from Matt Woleske's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1904">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-gb-3-17-01d1904/ gb-3-17-01], DeckTech (Matt "Ooryl_909" Woleske, 17 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-gb-3-17-01d1904/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobbytown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Mark Kloida]]
